title: Barcelona managers in order
brief: Name Barcelona's last ten permanent managers in order, from Frank Rijkaard in 2003. The label is the year each spell began.

notes.Lorenzo Serra Ferrer: Lorenzo Serra Ferrer (2000/01) is before this board starts.
notes.Carles Rexach: Carles Rexach (2001 to 2002) is before this board starts.
notes.Louis van Gaal: Louis van Gaal's second spell (2002 to 2003) is before this board starts.
notes.Radomir Antic: Radomir Antic (2003) is just before this board starts.
notes.Jordi Roura: Jordi Roura was only caretaker in 2013, while Tito Vilanova had cancer treatment.
notes.Sergi Barjuan: Sergi Barjuan was only caretaker, for three games between Koeman and Xavi in 2021.
notes.Antonio de la Cruz: Antonio de la Cruz was only caretaker, for one game in 2003.

checks: Every spell agrees between Wikipedia's list of Barcelona managers and Transfermarkt's staff history. Since 2000 there have been 14 permanent spells (Serra Ferrer, Rexach, Van Gaal, Antic, Rijkaard, Guardiola, Vilanova, Martino, Luis Enrique, Valverde, Setien, Koeman, Xavi, Flick), so the board takes the ten most recent, starting with Rijkaard in 2003. Caretakers left out: Antonio de la Cruz (2003), Jordi Roura (January to March 2013, standing in for Vilanova, whose spell counts once as Wikipedia has it) and Sergi Barjuan (2021). Transfermarkt dates Rijkaard, Guardiola, Luis Enrique and Valverde from 1 July, Wikipedia from the announcement; the years agree. Hansi Flick is still in charge in October 2026.
